name: Member 7
definition: Information about the members of a system.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Word by which something is called or known or the family name of a person.

ReturnAddress.name: Return Address
ReturnAddress.definition: Physical/logical address belonging to a member, segregated from its main address that is used for normal operations. The fund return address is used to route messages that require specific attention/exception handling, for example returns or rejects.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Nature of the relationship a member has with a system.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of a member in a system, for example enabled or deleted.

ContactReference.name: Contact Reference
ContactReference.definition: Person to be contacted in a given organisation.

CommunicationAddress.name: Communication Address
CommunicationAddress.definition: Number, or virtual address, used for communication.
